justiceSays.line: Marcus has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Hans passes around tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Word reaches you, days late: Sofia stands accused over what happened to Yara. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Hans has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Sofia answers for what happened to Yara.
Hans calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
Word reaches you, days late: Lena stands accused over what happened to Aroha. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Hans counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "0 for guilty. 6 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."
Aroha has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Lena answers for what happened to Aroha.
Aroha calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Hans counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "1 for guilty. 6 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
🔍 Erich has been turning over a tree heavy with smooth-skinned fruit blushing red and gold for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Aroha showed Emma the tree heavy with smooth-skinned fruit blushing red and gold — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Ramps. Broad smooth leaves, onion smell. Spring only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
